sources.dataset: Forebears — country-specific Most Common Last Names (2014 estimates)
sources.coverage: 1000 source rows; 999 unique NFC Latin-script surnames retained after punctuation/diacritic equivalence checks. Research-only partial pool (target 3000).
sources.limitations: National third-party incidence, not a state sample or an official Australian population surname register. Original entry 'Obrien' at rank 869 is excluded because 'O'Brien' already exists in preserved 500; equivalent punctuation variant. Estimated national surname incidence only; individual legal-register attestation and source redistribution rights are not independently established. Source ranks and frequencies never used for sampling.

sources.dataset: ProceduralTextGeneration — source-order transcription of country-specific Forebears surname table
sources.temporal_scope: GitHub source snapshot available by 2023, nominal Forebears 2014 estimated ranking
sources.coverage: 1000 observed rows; original initial 500 values preserved byte-for-byte and in original order.
sources.limitations: Unofficial mirror; licence not published, redistribution rights to be reviewed before production. Source ends at approximately rank 1000; other ethnonymic or pan-African lists were not treated as national residence evidence.

sources.dataset: Australian Electoral Commission — Federal election House of Representatives first preferences by candidate, 2025 and 2022; GitHub mirror bohemian-miser/polyticis
sources.geographical_scope: Australia nationwide across electoral divisions and states/territories; NOT a state-only source
sources.coverage: 2025: 654 additional distinct candidate surname spellings; 2022: 347; source Git blobs 2025 a62138f614ca3333cd83b26e71d11edefd435b2e, 2022 72480ab75e51a3d9aaeeebbe0214697efe60e552
sources.limitations: Surnames sourced from official AEC candidate results with separate Surname column; politician sample is nationally attested but not statistically representative of population. Original source capitalization preserved, may include all-uppercase display. Reuse licensing review remains
